node.title: Top-coefficient Vandermonde Schur reduction
node.statement: After a projective parameter-basis change making every joint-representation factor have nonzero leading coefficient, the top parameter-coefficient slice of the deficiency-aware matrix contains one scaled Vandermonde column per point of W and has rank 4m+1. Eliminating any square 4m+1 pivot block gives rank(M_W)=4m+1+rank(S_W), where the Schur matrix has |W|+Delta_W-(4m+1) columns. This is at most 4m-2 throughout |W|<=7m-1 and at most 3m-1 when O=0. Full column rank is therefore exactly the residual Schur full-rank problem; no residual rank bound is claimed.
